clue.text: American avoided bone eating second-rate course here

indicators.note: eating means the trimmed bone swallows the grade letter inside it
avoided means the American abbreviation is kept out of the bone's name

parts.note: the humerus is the bone of the upper arm
B is the second grade, so second-rate

explanation.surface: A diner skips a poor bone dish at some second-rate meal, with 'course' read as a menu course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Course' looks like a meal's course but means a river's course; 'here' just points at the place.
explanation.definitionFit: The named river is an English estuary, and a river's channel is called its course.

clue.text: Eradicate posh accent evident in extremely upper-class rearing

explanation.walkthrough: 'evident in' puts the accent between TOO and U, and 'rearing' turns the lot upwards in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: To eradicate something is to pull it out by the roots, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Party around entrance head for extra trifle

indicators.note: around means the party goes about the entrance

parts.note: a ball is a formal dance party
a gate is an entrance

indicators.note: head for means take only the first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: A party staged round the front gate, with something extra at the head, sounds like a lavish event.
explanation.definitionFit: Something of little importance, a mere nothing, is a bagatelle, a French-derived word for a trifle.

clue.text: Fluttering, one chirps, soft to loud?

definitions.text: Fluttering, one chirps, soft to loud?

indicators.note: fluttering suggests the letters flap about into a new order
in music p (piano) is soft and f (forte) is loud, so one letter is swapped for the other

explanation.surface: A bird flutters and chirps, its song swelling from soft to loud.
explanation.walkthrough: In ONECHIRPS the P (soft) becomes F (loud), giving ONECHIRFS to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: The rosefinch is a small songbird, so it flutters about and chirps.

clue.text: Third in Open? Woods? That's rubbish

yew and ash are both trees, and wood types

explanation.walkthrough: 'Woods' looks like the golfer Tiger Woods but gives two kinds of wood, one after the other.
explanation.definitionFit: Eyewash is nonsense said to deceive, an informal synonym for rubbish talk.

clue.text: According to rules, green's repositioned outside of line

parts.note: green's is read as green is, giving the word itself

indicators.note: outside of means the outer letters of the next word

explanation.definitionFit: This French phrase means in order, as regulations require, so it matches by the rules.

clue.text: Heath or Blair, as leading creater of fiction?

indicators.note: leading means the first letter of the following word

explanation.walkthrough: Heath and Blair suggest Ted and Tony; 'creater of fiction' steers Blair to Orwell's real first name.
explanation.definitionFit: Heather plants belong to a genus whose Latin name is also used for heath.

clue.text: One wriggles on front of chair after starter of iced jelly

on means placed above the rest in a down entry

front of means the opening letter of chair is taken

clue.text: Stamp of authority rearmost in call alarm — 'manufactured in Hong Kong'

explanation.definitionFit: A hallmark is an official mark punched into precious metal to certify its purity.

clue.text: The German grabs floor-mat alongside American person on trips

clue.text: Scorpion marks area tracking mate — horny creature

clue.text: During vacation in Guyana, a locum treated disease

explanation.definitionFit: Glaucoma is an eye disease in which raised pressure damages the optic nerve.

clue.text: Having made a touchdown, England shortly converted it. Class!

clue.text: Registered new Punto keeping check on edition

clue.text: Breaking the speed limits in Cardiff and Crewe causes vocal complaint

limits means the outer letters of each of the two towns

explanation.definitionFit: A lisp or stammer is an impairment of speaking, so a complaint affecting the voice.

clue.text: Heart of Texas in the USA's awfully empty

clue.text: Go gently, training old resident in game
